events.title: Connect with your Community Resource Navigator
Connect with your Community Resource Navigator

cases.refreshed: Looking for community resources or not sure where to start? Stop by Milpitas Library and meet Evelyn, your Community Resource Navigator, at our information table! Evelyn can help you explore resources and connect with services related to housing, food assistance, public benefits, employment, and more. Stop by our information table to ask questions, learn more about the program, or schedule an individual appointment for additional support. The Santa Clara County Library District's Community Resource Navigators page explains the program and lists services at other libraries.

cases.refreshed: Come practice your reading skills and read aloud to a friendly dog or cat -- your very own furry audience! You can bring a book from home or borrow one from the Children's Room. This program is perfect for emergent readers. Children in grades K-8 are welcome to participate. You may register for a 10-minute session online beginning two days before the event. Please only reserve spots for the children participating (not adults) and provide the child's name in the registration with parents' email information. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3947, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org.

events.title: To Be Read Book Club for Grades 6-8

cases.refreshed: Join our book club! The To Be Read Book Club is for anyone in 6th, 7th or 8th grade this school year. We are reading Stargirl by Jerry Spinelli for our meeting on Tuesday, November 24th, from 4 pm – 5 pm in the Orchard Room at Los Altos Library. If you can attend, register online and pick up your copy of the book at the Children's Reference Desk at either Los Altos or Woodland Library. Please read the book before our meeting. At the meeting, we will discuss the book and do a fun activity. Snacks will be provided. Many thanks to the Friends of the Los Altos Library for making this program possible. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3947, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org.
